court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Mrs. Kadambari W/O Praful Raut vs Shri Praful S/O Pundalikrao Raut
facts_of_case: The parties are the wife and husband, who got married under the Hindu Marriage Act. The wife has filed a petition for divorce. The trial court decided something, but this case came to appeal.

legal_principles.principle: A petition for divorce can be filed only on the ground of adultery, cruelty, desertion, or conversion.
legal_principles.held: The law is clear that a petition for divorce can be filed only on the ground of adultery, cruelty, desertion, or conversion.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove the grounds.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove the grounds.

outcome.final_order: Interim order in terms of prayer clause (c) in view of Section 15 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. Appeal be placed for final disposal on 24th January 2020.
